prerequisites.budget_rule: Matched 131,072-step training permitted only if feasibility gates 1-4 pass

gate1_interface_and_cpu_export.unit_tests: All 9/9 tests passed in both host and isolated Torch 2.1 CPU environments
gate1_interface_and_cpu_export.recurrent_reset_carry: Passed with exact bit-identical action traces across resets

gate2_gpu_training_smoke.cpu_screen_evaluation: Passed operational and determinism gates in isolated CPU 2.1 environment

failure_attribution.world_model_learning: Functioning properly: visual reconstruction is sharp (MSE 0.0086), continue accuracy is 99.2%, and reward correlation reaches +0.626.
failure_attribution.cpu_recurrent_state_handling: Functioning properly: 0.69 ms CPU latency, 330 MiB RSS, exact deterministic action traces, zero forbidden imports.
failure_attribution.algorithm_failure_mechanism: Continuous Tanh-Gaussian actor policy optimization collapsed into hard steering saturation (mean steering -0.99999, 95.4% saturation). Because tanh derivative vanishes at extreme inputs and exploration noise inside tanh is squashed to zero, the car immediately runs off track at step 109 in every episode. Replay becomes dominated by off-track grass driving (progress drops from 0.077 warmup to 0.019 policy), preventing policy improvement.

decision.verdict: Do not launch the expensive 131,072-decision matched training. DreamerV3 passed Gate 1 (CPU export & recurrent contract), Gate 2 (GPU training smoke), and Gate 3 (World Model learning diagnosis), but failed Gate 4 (small pilot policy learning due to premature continuous action saturation collapse). Retain the frozen DrQ-v2 control baseline as the reigning benchmark.
